intervals.note: Upgraded over summer 2017 to begin taking physics data; end date of operation not sourced in this session.
intervals.quote: CENNS-10 has been operating at the SNS since October 2016. Following an initial engineering run, CENNS-10 was upgraded over the summer of 2017 to begin taking physics data

intervals.label: first argon CEvNS observation
intervals.quote: Two independent analyses prefer CEvNS over the background-only null hypothesis with greater than 3-sigma significance.

summary.plain: A 22-kilogram tank of liquid argon that made the first measurement of coherent neutrino scattering off argon nuclei, a step toward the argon detectors used by much larger neutrino and dark-matter experiments.
summary.technical: 22 kg liquid argon calorimeter (CENNS-10), operating in Neutrino Alley at the SNS since October 2016; produced the first CEvNS-on-argon measurement (2021, >3-sigma, two independent analyses).

technology.note: Value narrowed to the wording on the cited page. The words single-phase and scintillation used in an earlier version are not stated on that page; the 2020 argon paper (src:cevns-coherent-argon-2021) describes photomultiplier-tube readout of argon scintillation light.
